advices.diagnosis: The class has a very high number of methods (NOM 26) and a high cyclomatic complexity (WMC 56), indicating a single class is handling many distinct responsibilities. The LCOM4 value of 5 shows the class is poorly cohesive, with methods touching unrelated attributes. The DCC of 4 suggests it is already referencing several other classes, but splitting responsibilities will reduce the number of collaborators per class and improve cohesion.

suggestions.title: Split OrderService into dedicated services

advices.risk_notes: The refactor may introduce coupling between the new services if they need to share state (e.g., the repository). Careful design of the façade and clear interfaces will mitigate this. Additionally, the change may affect performance if the delegation adds overhead, though this is likely negligible.
